title: 第七章 劝说
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
不过他说完后，门外的顾客却没敢立即进门，而是纷纷靠近玻璃墙面，仰着脖子朝店内张望。
“店长，你这里怎么没看到猫猫狗狗啊？”一个大学生打扮的女孩，代表众人问了出来。
“本店的猫狗暂时售罄，目前本店经营范围主要是鸟类，鱼类，龟类，以及兔子仓鼠等啮齿类小动物。”沐游解释道。
闻言，现场顿时有一大半人都露出了失望的表情。
对此沐游也没意外，虽说现在饲养各种小型家宠的人比例越来越多，但猫和狗，依然是养宠界的绝对主力，在数量上完全碾压了其他所有种类宠物的总和。
一般人想要养宠物，首先想到的还是猫狗。
眼看着一些顾客已经展露出离开的意向，沐游急忙开口：“各位可能以前没有接触过小型宠物，其实在我看来，饲养小型家宠的体验，未必就不如猫狗。”
这话一出，那边几个已经转身的顾客倒是都停了下来，准备先听听他的说法。
“猫狗的确是最常见的宠物，但却未必适合所有人，因为不管是猫还是狗，都是需要主人花费大量时间陪伴的动物，同时还得给它们提供足够的活动空间。而这两点，对于现在生活节奏极快的上班族和学生党们来说，其实都很难做到。”
“相比起来，饲养仓鼠等小型宠物，就不存在这个问题，因为体型小，它们往往只需要一个笼子或者鱼缸就足以养活，不占空间，还没有掉毛，异味等让饲主头疼的问题。此外还有更重要的一点：小型宠物照顾起来，比猫狗要省心太多了，它们不会占据主人太多的时间和精力，只需要定时换水粮，检查一下健康情况就可以，非常适合现代的快节奏生活。”
“当然，这并不是说，养猫狗就不如养小型宠物。猫狗属于伴侣型宠物，它们带来的强互动性，是其他小动物所无法比拟的。我的意思是，大家应该根据自己的条件，选择最合适的宠物。如果只是看了某个视频觉得可爱，就随便买了宠物回去，那么很可能在今后日复一日的铲屎生活中，消磨掉了爱心和耐心，最后走上卖宠甚至弃宠的道路……”
沐游微笑着看向众人，侃侃而谈，把众人听得一愣愣的。
大家都没想到养个宠物，居然有这么多说法。
现场的确有很多人，就是因为看到昨天视频中的仓鼠觉得可爱，便萌生了养宠物的想法，至于养宠物之后会遭遇的各种麻烦，却是很少有人仔细思考过。
更关键的是，沐游刚才并不只是单纯的说饲养小型宠物有多好，而是将饲养猫狗和饲养其他宠物的优缺点，全部罗列出来，让他们自己判断，这种做法本身就能给人一种可以信服的感觉。
这一下，之前那些原本已经准备离开的人，也都被沐游说动，有进店看看的意向了。
唯一还让他们犹豫的是，人家说了这么多，要是他们进去看了，结果不买，脸面上有点过不去。
“店长，我们不买，只进去参观一下可以吗？”之前的女学生小心翼翼的问道。
“当然可以！”
沐游微笑点头：“只要是进店的客人，都可以在前台，免费挑选一袋宠物饲料，喂给你喜欢的宠物。另外，大厅中间，宠物展示区里的那些动物，还可以直接上手互动，帮助顾客直接体验饲养它们的感觉。”

沐游这么一说，在场众人眼睛都是一亮。
他们最怕的就是一时冲动，买了宠物回去却又后悔，而现在能够直接体验宠物上手的感觉，效果就好的多了。
刚才那些稍有疑虑的人也算是彻底打消了顾虑，全都跃跃欲试的准备进店。
“等一下！”
不过这时，人群后方却传来一个不和谐的声音。
众人寻声看去，只见一个身材高挑，留着齐肩短发，身穿一袭白大褂的年轻女人，从人群最外围走来。
女人清冷的目光扫过，周围的人都是自觉地给她让出一条路。
白大褂女人走进人群，停在了店铺前方，先是透过玻璃窗看了眼店内的宠物，这才对着沐游伸出手：“你好，我叫赵倩，一名兽医，刚才凑巧经过，听到了你的说法，就过来看了下。”
“你好。”
沐游也伸手跟她握了一下。
两人握着的手一触即分，赵倩介绍完自己后，便皱眉看向沐游：“性格不好的啮齿类动物是会咬人的，尤其是对陌生人，随便上手抚摸，很容易被咬伤，你是开宠物店的，应该不会不知道这种常识吧？”
赵倩刚才也就是出来买早点，看到这边人群聚集，就过来看了眼，结果刚靠近就听到这家店老板的言论。
生性严谨的她，顿时有点忍不了了，她以前开的诊所里，不知道已经接待过多少因为随便触摸仓鼠而被咬穿手指的案例了，为了避免眼皮子底下出现这种惨剧，这才决定出言提醒。
“性格不好的仓鼠会咬人，这我当然知道。”
沐游闻言笑了笑，解释道：“所以我也强调了，只有宠物展示区的宠物，可以上手摸。这些宠物都是我亲自挑选的，性格温顺黏人，而且经过了我的训练，我可以保证，除非有人故意伤害激怒它们，否则只要是正常的交流互动，它们绝不会咬人！”
“那如果你的宠物在顾客的正常互动中咬了人呢？”赵倩并没有这么简单就相信，而是继续追问道。
“如果出现这种情况，我全权负责，支付所有医疗费用，并且给被咬者一万元作为补偿！”沐游毫不犹豫的说。
众人听得吃惊，敢当众放下这种狠话，至少说明这老板对他的宠物是有着绝对信心的！
赵倩也点了点头，这老板都说到了这个份上，她再追问的话，就是质疑人家的人品了。
“我也进去参观一下，可以吧？”赵倩问。

“当然。”
沐游微笑，让到一旁，做出请的手势。
赵倩带头走进了店内。
其他人一看有人带头，也是彻底没了犹豫，一窝蜂的涌进了店内。
content_en:
However, after he finished speaking, the customers outside the door did not dare to enter immediately. Instead, they approached the glass wall and looked into the store with their necks raised.
"Store manager, why don't you see any cats or dogs here?" A girl dressed as a college student asked on behalf of everyone.
"Our store's cats and dogs are temporarily sold out. At present, our store's business scope is mainly birds, fish, turtles, and small rodents such as rabbits and hamsters." Mu You explained.
Hearing this, most of the people at the scene suddenly showed disappointed expressions.
Mu You is not surprised by this. Although more and more people are keeping various small domestic pets, cats and dogs are still the absolute main force in the pet industry, completely overwhelming all other types of pets combined in terms of numbers.
When most people want to keep pets, the first thing they think of is cats and dogs.
Seeing that some customers were already showing their intention to leave, Muyou hurriedly said: "You may have never been exposed to small pets before. In fact, in my opinion, the experience of raising small domestic pets is not necessarily inferior to cats and dogs."
As soon as he said this, several customers who had turned around stopped and were ready to listen to what he had to say.
"Cats and dogs are indeed the most common pets, but they may not be suitable for everyone, because both cats and dogs are animals that require their owners to spend a lot of time with them, and at the same time, they must be provided with enough space for activities. These two points are actually difficult to achieve for office workers and students who live at an extremely fast pace."
"In comparison, raising small pets such as hamsters does not have this problem. Because of their small size, they often only need a cage or fish tank to feed them. They do not take up space, and there are no hair loss, odor and other headaches for owners. In addition, there is a more important point: small pets are much easier to take care of than cats and dogs. They do not take up too much time and energy of the owner. They only need to change water and food regularly and check their health. They are very suitable for modern fast-paced life."
"Of course, this does not mean that keeping cats and dogs is inferior to keeping small pets. Cats and dogs are companion pets, and the strong interactivity they bring is unmatched by other small animals. What I mean is that everyone should choose the most suitable pet according to their own conditions. If you just buy a pet after watching a video and find it cute, then it is very likely that in the future, you will lose your love and patience in the day-to-day life of shoveling shit, and finally embark on the road of selling pets or even abandoning them..."
Mu You looked at everyone with a smile and talked eloquently, leaving everyone stunned.
No one expected that there would be so many opinions about raising a pet.
There were indeed many people at the scene who came up with the idea of ​​raising a pet just because they saw the hamster in yesterday's video and thought it was cute. As for the various troubles that will be encountered after raising a pet, few people have thought carefully about it.
More importantly, Muyou didn't just say how good it is to raise small pets, but listed all the advantages and disadvantages of raising cats, dogs and other pets for them to judge for themselves. This approach itself can give people a convincing feeling.
At this time, those who had been preparing to leave before were also persuaded by Muyan to enter the store and have a look.
The only thing that still makes them hesitate is that after everyone has said so much, if they go in to look at it and don't buy it, they will feel a little embarrassed.
"Store manager, we don't want to buy, can we just go in and have a look?" the female student from before asked cautiously.
"Of course!"
Mu You smiled and nodded: "As long as you are a customer entering the store, you can choose a bag of pet food for free at the front desk and feed it to your favorite pet. In addition, you can directly interact with the animals in the pet display area in the middle of the hall to help customers directly experience the feeling of raising them."
When Mu You said this, everyone's eyes lit up.What they fear most is to buy a pet on impulse and regret it later. But now that they can directly experience the feeling of using a pet, the effect is much better.
Those who had some doubts just now had their worries completely dispelled, and they were all eager to enter the store.
"Wait a minute!"
But at this time, a discordant voice came from behind the crowd.
Everyone looked around and saw a tall young woman with shoulder-length hair and a white coat walking from the outermost edge of the crowd.
The woman's cold gaze swept over her, and everyone around her consciously made way for her.
The woman in the white coat walked into the crowd and stopped in front of the store. She first looked at the pets in the store through the glass window, and then stretched out her hand to Mu You: "Hello, my name is Zhao Qian, a veterinarian. I just happened to pass by and heard what you said, so I came over to take a look."
"Hello."
Mu You also reached out and shook her hand.
The hands held by the two of them broke apart at the touch. After Zhao Qian introduced herself, she frowned and looked at Mu You: "Rodents with bad personalities will bite, especially to strangers. If you touch them casually, you will be easily bitten. You run a pet shop, so you shouldn't know this common sense, right?"
Zhao Qian just came out to buy breakfast. When she saw the crowd gathering here, she came over to take a look. As a result, she heard the words of the owner of the store as she approached.
Being strict by nature, she suddenly couldn't bear it anymore. In the clinic she opened before, she had received countless cases of fingers being bitten through casually touching hamsters. In order to avoid such a tragedy happening right under her nose, she decided to give a warning.
"Hamsters with bad personalities will bite, of course I know that."
Mu You smiled when he heard this and explained: "So I also emphasized that only the pets in the pet display area can be touched. These pets are all selected by me personally. They have a docile and clingy personality, and after my training, I can guarantee that unless someone intentionally hurts and provokes them, they will never bite as long as there is normal interaction!"
"What if your pet bites someone during a normal interaction with a customer?" Zhao Qian did not believe it so simply, but continued to ask.
"If this happens, I will take full responsibility and pay all medical expenses and give the person who was bitten 10,000 yuan as compensation!" Mu You said without hesitation.
Everyone was surprised to hear such cruel words, which at least showed that the boss had absolute confidence in his pet!
Zhao Qian also nodded. The boss had already mentioned this. If she asked further, she would be questioning his character.
"I'll go in and have a look too, okay?" Zhao Qian asked.
"Of course."
Mu You smiled, stepped aside, and made a gesture of invitation.
Zhao Qian took the lead and walked into the store.
When the others saw someone taking the lead, they lost all hesitation and swarmed into the store.
